goal: Sync PRD/task status to target repos so distributed teams have visibility and don't duplicate work
success_criteria: Contributors can see planned work, claim tasks, and status updates propagate via git

features.title: Define .hq/ directory structure
features.description: Document standard location in repos for distributed tracking files
acceptance_criteria: Documents .hq/ directory with: prd.json, claims.json, sync-log.json
Each file has JSON schema defined
features.notes: Created structure.md with JSON schemas for prd.json, claims.json, sync-log.json. Includes .gitignore recommendations.

features.title: Add push-to-repo function
features.description: Push PRD/task status to target repo's .hq/ directory
acceptance_criteria: Includes: full PRD, task status, worker assignments, notes
Adds synced_at timestamp and synced_from field
Commits with message: sync: update distributed tracking
features.notes: Added 'Distributed Tracking - Push to Repo' section to pure-ralph-base.md. Documents push_to_repo function with: mkdir for .hq dir, sync_metadata with synced_at/synced_from/synced_by, what gets synced (full PRD, features, status, notes), example, and commit strategy options.

features.title: Add pull-from-repo function
features.description: Pull latest status from repo before starting work
acceptance_criteria: Returns diff summary (tasks added, changed, removed)
features.notes: Worker: knowledge-curator. Selection reason: Documentation task adding instructions to prompt file. Added 'Distributed Tracking - Pull from Repo' section with: pull_from_repo function steps, diff detection logic comparing by task ID, comparison table for fields, example output format, and explicit no-auto-overwrite policy.

features.title: Add conflict detection and merge
features.description: Detect conflicts between local and repo PRD, merge intelligently
acceptance_criteria: When local and repo differ: show task-level diff
Merge strategy: per-task, newer updated_at wins
Merged result written to both local and repo
features.notes: Worker: knowledge-curator. Selection reason: Documentation task adding instructions to prompt file. Added 'Distributed Tracking - Conflict Resolution' section with: task-level diff display format, merge strategy (per-task, newer updated_at wins), updated_at requirement documentation, user confirmation prompt with y/n/manual options, manual resolution flow, write-to-both-locations process, example merge flow, and conflict states table.

features.title: Add duplicate work detection
features.description: Warn when planning work that already exists in repo
acceptance_criteria: On PRD creation: check if .hq/prd.json exists in target repo
If exists: show existing tasks, ask add or create separate
Fuzzy match task titles to catch near-duplicates
Warning shown before PRD is saved
features.notes: Added Step 2.5 'Check for Duplicate Work (Distributed Tracking)' to prd.md. Includes: bash script to check for .hq/prd.json, task table display, fuzzy matching logic (normalize, exact/contains/word overlap >50%), and A/B/C prompt before proceeding.

features.title: Add task claim mechanism
features.description: Claim tasks before starting to prevent conflicts
acceptance_criteria: claims.json schema: task_id, claimed_by, claimed_at, expires_at
Before task: check if claimed by someone else
If claimed: show warning with claimer info and timestamp

features.title: Integrate with pure-ralph loop
acceptance_criteria: On loop start: pull from repo, warn on conflicts
Before each task: check claim, claim if available
After each task: push status to repo
On loop complete: push final, release claims

features.title: Add /sync-tasks slash command
features.description: Manual sync command for ad-hoc status checks
acceptance_criteria: Shows clear summary of sync result

metadata.purpose: Enable distributed teams to share PRD/task status via git
